business_summary: Huasheng International Holding Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the production and sale of ready-mixed commercial concrete in the People's Republic of China. It is also involved in production and sale of cement and construction materials and concrete; provision of management services; and property investment activities. The company was formerly known as Newtree Group Holdings Limited and changed its name to Huasheng International Holding Limited in March 2020. Huasheng International Holding Limited was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Huasheng International Holding Limited는 중화인민공화국에서 레미콘 상업용 콘크리트의 생산 및 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. 또한 시멘트, 건축자재, 콘크리트의 생산 및 판매에도 참여하고 있습니다. 관리 서비스 제공; 및 부동산 투자 활동. 이 회사는 이전에 Newtree Group Holdings Limited로 알려져 있었으며 2020년 3월에 Huasheng International Holding Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. Huasheng International Holding Limited는 2010년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 완차이에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
